name: Explainer
description: How or why something works or happened, made clear step by step. Pick it when the viewer should come away understanding one thing.

structure.purpose: Ask the question the video answers, in its most surprising form.
Say what the viewer or the world gains or loses from the answer.
Explain the first half of the answer with one clear picture for each idea.
Explain the rest, building on what was just shown.
The fact or turn the viewer did not see coming.
Say the answer once more in one plain sentence, and end on it.

hookRules: The first 3 seconds show the most striking image or line. No greeting and no logo intro.
Within 10 seconds it is clear what someone could lose or gain.

rules: Every number, date and name comes from a saved source.
A rounded figure is spoken as about, nearly or more than, never as exact.
What is not known or is disputed is said to be so.
